The orc shamans keep magical equipment in their hideout, the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave}. Go down two floors of the cave and find the skeleton, guarded by {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans}, where 3 {item:Blank Rune|Blank Runes} are.

Between levels 8 and 30 this cave has tough creatures and the rewards are not great. Gather a team and do all the quests of the cave at once, instead of making several trips.
Bring potions or the {spell:Cure Poison} spell because of the {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}.

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

The cave is on a peninsula **southwest** of Edron castle, reached through a sewer in the basement of the **Edron Flats** (the apartments right **south** of the castle). In the orc area, go to the entrance of the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave}, dig it open with the {item:Shovel} if it is covered and go down.

Never go without a {item:Shovel}: the entrance always has to be dug open and, without a shovel, you cannot get back to Edron without the help of other players. There are orcs on every floor, including the surface.

Down there you only find {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}. Follow the cave **west** and then **south**. There are a few side rooms, but basically there is only one path.
Map of the first floor of the Edron Orc Cave

On the second floor there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors} and {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}. After you drop to this floor, walk **west** to a three-way junction.
Map of the second floor to the shamans' room
At the junction, keep going **north** and then **west**. The right room is at the **northwest** end of the floor and has a {item:Sacrificial Stone} in the centre.
The room is guarded by 2 to 3 {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans}.
Kill the shamans and open the skeleton in the room: inside are 3 {item:Blank Rune|Blank Runes}.

Go back the same way: in the shamans' room head **east** and **south** to the junction and then **east** to the spot where you dropped; use the {item:Rope} to climb to the first floor. There head **north** and **east** to the entrance and use the Rope again to get out to the surface. To return to Edron, go back through the **Edron Flats** passage (with the {item:Shovel}, if the entrance is covered); at the harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities.
